name: Home Assistant texts
author: OwnPBX
description: Texting for Home Assistant and the ESP32-S3-Box panel: an inbox and a send address with a token, the same /messages/inbox and /messages/send the old PBX had. A panel's extension sees its Chat messages and the SMS of the numbers its user has; it texts extensions through Chat and phone numbers through SMS.

description_i18n.en: Texting for Home Assistant and the ESP32-S3-Box panel: an inbox and a send address with a token, the same /messages/inbox and /messages/send the old PBX had. A panel's extension sees its Chat messages and the SMS of the numbers its user has; it texts extensions through Chat and phone numbers through SMS.

settings_schema.label: Extensions that may use it (comma separated, e.g. 8803)
settings_schema.help: Leave empty for none: every panel or Home Assistant extension must be listed.

settings_schema.label: Chat messages
settings_schema.help: Show direct Chat messages with other extensions, and send to extensions through Chat.

settings_schema.label: SMS
settings_schema.help: Show the texts of the SMS numbers the extension's user has, and send to phone numbers through SMS (needs the SMS plugin).
